description: This file defines an interface 'XmlSerializable' with methods for serializing an object to XML and deserializing from an XML element, used within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: XmlSerializable
classes.description: An interface for objects that can be serialized to and deserialized from XML.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts an XML element back into an object of type T.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object into an XML element.
